title: ReceiptBinding
description: The harness receipt binding (design §3.3): the canonical digest of this document is signed as engine receipt payloadHash, keeping the nested SignedReceipt byte-for-byte engine-compatible. All hashes are lowercase hex sha-256.

scopeHash.description: lowercase hex sha-256 over the canonical scope (REQ-SCOPE-008)

targetHash.description: lowercase hex sha-256 over the executed target

evidenceHash.description: lowercase hex sha-256 over the id-sorted evidence set
